# Tesseract.js browser OCR assets

Vendored for on-device card-name recognition. Photos remain in the browser.

- `tesseract.js` 7.0.0 (Apache-2.0)
- `tesseract.js-core` 7.0.0 (Apache-2.0)
- `@tesseract.js-data/eng` 1.0.0 (MIT)

Sources: https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js and https://github.com/naptha/tessdata
